query:
SELECT mc.characterName, mc.cardNumber, mc.cardType, mc.parallels, ms.name as setName
FROM marvel_cards mc
JOIN marvel_sets ms ON mc.setId = ms.id
WHERE mc.parallels IS NOT NULL AND mc.parallels != 'NULL' AND mc.parallels LIKE '%/%'
AND mc.characterName IN (
    SELECT characterName FROM (
        SELECT characterName, SUM(
            (LENGTH(parallels) - LENGTH(REPLACE(parallels, '/', '')))
        ) as slash_count
        FROM marvel_cards
        WHERE parallels IS NOT NULL AND parallels != 'NULL' AND parallels LIKE '%/%'
        GROUP BY characterName
        ORDER BY slash_count ASC
        LIMIT 5
    ) sub
)
ORDER BY mc.characterName;
